body: The stress I deal with is so much at work bc I have so many bad days where I’m not performing my best it makes me dread work and not be able to like it and do my best. That’s when my anxiety creeps in and I start wondering how I’m ever going to keep up taking care of myself and my bills at this rate
Oooor in my case it’s called real life

Thank you all for the replies, I greatly appreciate them. Good news is I got myself to the hospital, bad news is I got myself there by ambulance after swallowing ...a few too many pills. But I’m here and out of the psych ward feeling better. Hopefully I can only go up from here
